items.title: θ₁=θ₂=45° — y-sections
items.body:
Each angle is arctan|fᵧ(0.5,0.5)|.
The y-edges and their horizontal guides
are parallel, so the angles are equal.

items.title: θ₃=45° — x-section
items.body:
The green angle is arctan|fₓ(0.5,0.5)|.
All three angles equal 45° here because
fₓ(0.5,0.5)=fᵧ(0.5,0.5)=1.
